connector.name: Rag Vault
connector.registryDescription: Local RAG MCP server with hybrid search, PDF/DOCX support, and zero-config setup
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package rag-vault. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the robthepcguy account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.
connector.authNote: No credential is declared in the registry record. A hosted endpoint may still apply its own rate limits or sign in step.

env.name: BASE_DIR
env.description: Base directory for document storage (defaults to current working directory)

env.name: DB_PATH
env.description: Path to LanceDB database directory (defaults to ./lancedb/)

env.name: CACHE_DIR
env.description: Directory where Transformers.js models are cached (defaults to ./models/)

env.name: RAG_HYBRID_WEIGHT
env.description: Keyword boost strength for hybrid search. 0.0 = semantic only, 1.0 = keyword only. Default 0.6

env.name: RAG_GROUPING
env.description: Grouping mode: 'similar' (top group only) or 'related' (top 2 groups)
